summary: Full acceptance testing of redesigned /live-signals and /future-signals plus regression on /injector. All 9 review scenarios PASS. Desktop premium: /live-signals renders data-testid live-signals-page, no h1 above broker bar, signal-broker-name defaults to 'Quotex' (with localStorage cleared), OTC/Real tabs switch (28 real tiles), search 'EUR' narrows to 7 OTC tiles, broker picker opens showing binolla/quotex/pocketoption with quotex data-on=true, Escape closes it, picking Pocket Option updates name and persists across reload. Confirm step shows 'EUR/USD (OTC)', live-rule-duration='1 Minute', live-rule-mtg='1 Step MTG'; live-change-market returns to grid. Generate → live-analyzing shows with live-analyzing-line cycling ('Reading market pressure' seen among others) → ~10s later live-result with UP pill, live-verdict-direction='UP' matching pill, live-broker-line contains 'Pocket Option', injector-chart SVG present, live-entry-time '02:16' consistent with rule (start seconds=12 <30 → next minute), live-duration='1 Min', live-mtg='1 Step MTG'; live-reset returns to market step. /future-signals: no h1, broker bar present, future-build-step with presets 3/5/10/15, count clamps 99→20 and 0→1, generate button disabled with no selection and shows 'Select markets to build a queue'. Picking OTC EURUSD sets aria-pressed=true and shows chip; switching to Real tab shows future-lock-hint and Real tiles carry disabled attribute. Adding GBPUSD, preset 3 → button reads 'Generate 3 Future Signals'. Generate → future-analyzing → future-result with future-broker-line ('Quotex'), future-mix showing 1 up + 2 down (matched card directions [DOWN, DOWN, UP]), exactly 3 cards future-signal-0..2 (no signal-3), entries 02:19/02:24/02:32 strictly increasing and in the future, markets alternate EUR/GBP. future-reset returns to build. Free-tier gate: qatester01 demoted to 'free' via admin API; on both /live-signals and /future-signals generate shows 'Unlock the full experience' modal and no analyzing starts; tier restored to standard. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow on either page; broker bar fits (358x69.5); picker is a bottom-sheet at bottom of viewport with 3 cards side-by-side (arc lift for Quotex is intentional per brokers.ts); live-result 3 stat tiles render with entry+duration on one row and mtg full-width below. Design borders (rgba(168,128,255,0.2-0.22) and rgba(139,92,255,0.55)) confirmed violet-tinted for .sig-broker, .inj-panel, .inj-tile, .inj-btn — none white/grey. Injector regression: single injection on NZD/CHF (OTC), 5 Min → injector-result with injector-verdict-direction='DOWN', injector-entry-time='02:19', injector-duration='5 Min'. Admin API usage counts confirm increments: live-signals 2→3, future-signals +3, injector 4→5.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile broker picker cards have staggered y positions (ys=[713,702,690]) due to intentional 'lift' values in /app/frontend/lib/brokers.ts (Quotex lift:-26). This matches the arc-card design; if the spec meant strictly-flat 'one row', consider a mobile-specific override — but current UX looks intentional and pleasant.

future-signals view instantiates useBroker locally, so if user changes broker on /live-signals in same tab (via storage event) /future-signals correctly reflects it — verified through code path (BROKER_STORAGE_KEY 'coco:broker' + storage/custom event listeners in useBroker).
